audit_conclusions.required_shape: per-unit-bearing-field evidence list: field identity + provider-native lexeme or explicit unknown; supports multiple fields and accepts an empty list for families with no unit-bearing field

durable_authority_trace.authority: durable ProjectionSchemaDefinition registered in the T0B projection schema registry (DurableJsonCatalog under the T0 root); the registry reload validates every committed fragment and physical projections are re-verified against the registered schema
forbidden_sources: test fixtures outside the registered schema contract
durable_authority_trace.handoff_path: Bloc5Handoff resolves (projection_schema_id, projection_schema_version) carried on every projection artifact and copies the durable declarations verbatim into RawNormalizationBatch.source_unit_evidence
durable_authority_trace.physical_binding: the projection writer requires the rows' exact field set to equal the registered provider-native schema, and the artifact commit re-reads the Parquet schema for exact equality with the registered schema

MECHANICAL_BASIS.notes: basis_native is a spread/premium value; basis_bps is a derived additive field. No unit-bearing field exists.

MECHANICAL_BOOK_METRIC.notes: methodology_id / methodology_version remain mandatory; the unit lexeme is a provider-native measurement label.

metric_unit.lexeme_type: provider-native string (e.g. depth units, bps, contract counts) preserved verbatim

MECHANICAL_BOOK_SNAPSHOT.notes: The unit rides on each repeated PriceLevel child record; a single record-level scalar native_unit cannot represent it. Any T0 provider-native projection must therefore expose the per-level unit field(s) it actually stores, or declare none.

MECHANICAL_FUNDING.notes: funding_rate_native is a dimensionless rate; the funding interval is described by funding_interval_seconds, not by a unit lexeme. No unit-bearing field exists.

MECHANICAL_LIQUIDATION.notes: liquidation_usd / liquidation_quote_native are derived or provider-reported notional values, not unit declarations.

quantity_unit.lexeme_type: provider-native string or absent (the accepted schema allows an explicit unknown as None)

MECHANICAL_OPEN_INTEREST.notes: oi_base / oi_quote / oi_usd are additive normalized fields owned by a normalizing layer and are explicitly NOT the T0 authority (B1-T12: native value + native unit are always retained).

MECHANICAL_POSITIONING.notes: Ratios and population counts carry no unit lexeme; population_definition is mandatory and is not a unit.

MECHANICAL_TRADE.notes: quantity_native + quote_notional_native are values; quantity_unit names the unit of quantity_native. quote_notional_usd is a derived additive field and is never the T0 unit authority.

quantity_unit.lexeme_type: provider-native string (base asset symbol, contract count label, ...) preserved verbatim

storage_gap_before_repair.consequence: a public Bloc 5 consumer could not determine native unit semantics without provider/private knowledge
